authority: bimanual-robot is the maintained source after import
scope: all ROS packages, drivers, firmware, launch/config, evaluation code and operator scripts

source_preservation_notes: Core runtime algorithms, real URDF, four-wheel firmware and calibration bytes preserved; path/entrypoint and test-fixture adjustments are listed separately.
Legacy whitespace attributes preserve upstream source bytes, sealed fixture hashes and unified patch context. New runtime tools keep the default whitespace checks.
AMCL Axis B five known failing tests are retained without changing their decision-pending behavior.
